degree_rationale: The Five Sayings (foundational names/teachings of Father, Father of Life, etc.) on which Mind and Faith are founded. Treats the essential names — the very identity-formulas of celestial powers.
direction_rationale: The naming-illumination — sayings by which the unutterable Father becomes spoken in the assembly. Illuminates the celestial as proclaimed.
grand_man_function: Celestial proclamation — the inmost names/sayings illuminating love.
title: The Five Sayings: foundational teachings to be taught
